title: Vehicle Service Contracts Transfer Terms
content:
Under every DriveSure plan of Vehicle Service Contracts, the service contract may be transferred to a private buyer of the vehicle once the retail installment contract is paid off, on the terms below.

| Plan | Transfer allowed | Transfer fee (USD) | Window after the vehicle's private sale (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| DriveSure Powertrain | Yes | 50.00 | 30 |
| DriveSure Powertrain Plus | Yes | 50.00 | 30 |
| DriveSure Silver | Yes | 50.00 | 30 |
| DriveSure Gold | Yes | 50.00 | 30 |
| DriveSure Platinum | Yes | 50.00 | 30 |
| DriveSure Exclusionary | Yes | 50.00 | 30 |

- Transfer allowed: whether the service contract may be transferred to a private buyer of the vehicle once the retail installment contract is paid off.
- Transfer fee: the fee for a transfer, in USD.
- Window: the calendar days after the vehicle's private sale within which a transfer must be requested.

Every plan carries the same three figures, so a transfer under DriveSure Powertrain and a transfer under DriveSure Exclusionary cost the same 50.00 and must be requested within the same 30 calendar days after the private sale.
